# ---- vectorized NaN-aware hazen, column-wise ----
def hazen_cols(P):
    s = np.sort(P, axis=0)
    n = np.count_nonzero(~np.isnan(P), axis=0)
    v = 0.9*n - 0.5
    lo = np.floor(v).astype(np.int64); frac = v - lo

    q = s[lo_c, cols] + frac*(s[hi_c, cols]-s[lo_c, cols])
    q[n == 0] = np.nan
    return q
